title: Introduction to NotebookLM
description: Welcome to NotebookLM! Whether you are a student organizing research, a marketer analyzing customer feedback, or a curious learner exploring new topics, you'll find everything you need to know for getting up to speed with the app. Try asking questions in chat with specific details about your project; NotebookLM will give you detailed tips tailored to your unique needs. Or you can dive deep into a wide range of content to help you become a NotebookLM power user, including Slide Decks and Audio Overviews, that walk you through the features and document the many ways that NotebookLM can help you explore and understand the information that matters most to you.
author: NotebookLM
